name: C# Apps & Games
shortDescription: C# applications and Unity 2D/3D games — won Best Overall at UWGDC Game Jam Fall 2024. Includes computer-vision-driven projects and FSM-based gameplay.
description:
A collection of C# work spanning vision-driven applications and Unity games — including the Best Overall winner at UWGDC Game Jam Fall 2024.

Highlights:
- Wrote C# code in Visual Studio 2022 using Emgu OpenCV as the computer-vision element for a larger alarm system.
- Developed complex game logic using C# scripting in Unity for 2D and 3D games (physics, colliders, AI logic).
- Utilized finite state machines for smooth animation transitions and character behaviour, leading to more interactivity.
- Employed version control (Git) to manage codebase changes and collaborate with teammates effectively.
- Conducted extensive testing and debugging to identify and fix issues, ensuring a polished final product.
